from itertools import combinations
points=set(coords)
rect_candidates=[]
for r0,r1 in combinations(sorted(set(r for r,c in coords)),2):
 for c0,c1 in combinations(sorted(set(c for r,c in coords)),2):
  if {(r0,c0),(r0,c1),(r1,c0),(r1,c1)}<=points:
   edge=[(r0,c) for c in range(c0,c1+1)]+[(r1,c) for c in range(c0,c1+1)]+[(r,c0) for r in range(r0,r1+1)]+[(r,c1) for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
   cov=len(set(edge)&points)/len(set(edge))
   rect_candidates.append((r0,r1,c0,c1,cov,len(set(edge)&points),len(set(edge))))
rect_candidates=sorted(rect_candidates,key=lambda x:((x[1]-x[0])*(x[3]-x[2]),-x[4]),reverse=True)
rect_candidates[:30]
